blocks.prompt: 7 Aslam deposited Rs. 5000 on opening an account in a bank 15 years ago. Using differential equation, find the constant annual rate of growth if he closes his account now by receiving Rs. 15,000.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bank mein paisa badhne ka sawal hai. Raqam jitni zyada ho, us par munafa utna hi zyada, is liye badhne ki raftar raqam ke proportional hai.
Model: \(\frac{dA}{dt} = rA\); yahan \(r\) hi maloom karna hai.
Diya kya hai? Shuru mein 5000, aur 15 saal baad 15000.
Plan: \(A = 5000e^{rt}\) mein \(t = 15\) rakh kar \(\ln\) se \(r\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(0) = 5000\), \(A(15) = 15000\) rupay; \(t\) saalon mein.
Maloom karna: salana growth rate \(r\).
Tareeqa: growth model \(\frac{dA}{dt} = rA\) (Exercise 4.1 ke Question 2 jaisa), jo separable hai.

Differential equation hal karein
\[\int\dfrac{dA}{A} = r\int dt\]
\[A = ce^{rt}\]
\[A(0) = 5000 \Rightarrow c = 5000\]
\[A = 5000e^{rt}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya, \(e\) liya, aur \(t = 0\) par \(e^{0} = 1\) se \(c\) shuru wali raqam bani.

\(A(15) = 15000\) lagayein
\[15000 = 5000e^{15r}\]
\[e^{15r} = 3\]
\[15r = \ln 3\]
\[r = \dfrac{\ln 3}{15} \approx \dfrac{1.098612}{15}\]
\[r \approx 0.07324 = 7.32\%\]
Kyun: 5000 se divide kiya to raqam teen guna nikli, \(e^{15r} = 3\). Phir \(\ln\) liya aur 15 se divide kiya. Decimal rate ko 100 se multiply karne par percentage milta hai.
Dhyan dein: jawab 0.07324 nahi, 7.32% likhein, kyunke rate poochha gaya hai.

Tasdeeq
\[5000e^{0.07324(15)} = 5000e^{1.0986} \approx 15000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: is rate se 15 saal mein raqam sach mein 15000 ban jati hai.
